race.comment: BILLIE THE GREAT (3) is racing in great heart including a BM68 win last time. Big jump in weight while coming back in grade but offset to the tune of 4kg for the claimer. Yet to win here in seven tries but has placed five times. Hard to fault recent form. WILD NIGHTS (6) found the line strongly this course and distance last time. Expected to do much better. ZOETE'S ROCK (2) has a good record over this course and distance and freshened for the sharper trip. Aided by the claim and looks tough to stop. GEEGEESCHASER (11) should be ready to fire after two runs back and hasn't been far away. Doesn't win out of turn but gets a chance with the light weight. OUR PEPMENARTIE (7) wasn't too far off the mark last time.
